title: Extended Mark IR 4
description: The one IR the xtmd compiler writes and every engine runs: Extended Mark, checked and lowered. No Markdown is left in it, and it holds only what the page can run. This schema is the source of the Rust and TypeScript types.

module.description: One build: the document (or pack) with the parts of core and of the given packs it uses, checked and lowered, ready to run.

version.description: The IR's version: a whole number of its own, apart from xtmd's version. 0.4 writes 4.

xtmd.description: The version of the compiler that wrote it.

module.description: `doc` for a document, or the pack's name.

levels.description: Every level the page needs: the union of its calls'.

front_matter.description: A document's YAML front matter, without its --- lines, passed to the host untouched (page 1).

level.description: A level an engine has (page 6): core.draw draws the extern widgets, core.live holds variables and runs events, core.gfx draws the canvas widgets. An engine lists the ones it has, and a call, a widget or a page lists the ones it needs: none means its Markdown is enough.

needs.description: Every extern the page uses, by who supplies it. An engine checks the list when it mounts the page.

core.description: core's externs, supplied by the engine: widgets and fns.

host.description: Every value and fn taken from the host, by its full name: a value of core's page (`core/page.width`), and the values and fns of the document's own channels (`doc/scores.unit`).

oneOf.description: The document's one `$state` block.
A top-level `let`: a constant, or a value worked out again when what it reads changes.

name.description: A declaration's full name: its pack, a slash, its name (`core/date`, `doc/task`). A fn on a type adds a dot and the fn's name (`core/list.some`).

oneOf.description: A type alias: another name for a type. A contract written after the alias's name adds to its own (`core/int` is `core/number` with step 1).

name.description: A declaration's full name: its pack, a slash, its name (`core/date`, `doc/task`). A fn on a type adds a dot and the fn's name (`core/list.some`).

same.description: The fn `==` and `!=` call, when the record's pack writes one. Left out, records compare field by field.

name.description: A declaration's full name: its pack, a slash, its name (`core/date`, `doc/task`). A fn on a type adds a dot and the fn's name (`core/list.some`).

ordered.description: Its cases carry nothing, so they are ordered as written.

token.description: A token type: an enum whose cases stand for values of one type.

name.description: A declaration's full name: its pack, a slash, its name (`core/date`, `doc/task`). A fn on a type adds a dot and the fn's name (`core/list.some`).

value.description: The type of the value each case stands for.

values.description: Each named case's value, from the tokens blocks of the build. An engine may give its own.

name.description: A declaration's full name: its pack, a slash, its name (`core/date`, `doc/task`). A fn on a type adds a dot and the fn's name (`core/list.some`).

fns.description: The names of its fns. A call of one is sent to the fn of the value's own type.

fn_decl.description: A fn written in Extended Mark. One with no return type is an action.

name.description: A declaration's full name: its pack, a slash, its name (`core/date`, `doc/task`). A fn on a type adds a dot and the fn's name (`core/list.some`).

extern.description: Something supplied from outside Extended Mark.

name.description: A declaration's full name: its pack, a slash, its name (`core/date`, `doc/task`). A fn on a type adds a dot and the fn's name (`core/list.some`).

default.description: The default body, run when the supplier gives none.

oneOf.description: An extern fn: native to every engine (core's), a pack's, or the host's.

name.description: A declaration's full name: its pack, a slash, its name (`core/date`, `doc/task`). A fn on a type adds a dot and the fn's name (`core/list.some`).

tokens.description: The tokens the page itself is drawn with, from the block's `tokens` line.

oneOf.description: An extern block: values the host gives and fns Extended Mark calls.

name.description: A declaration's full name: its pack, a slash, its name (`core/date`, `doc/task`). A fn on a type adds a dot and the fn's name (`core/list.some`).

supplier.description: Who supplies an extern: the engine (core's), the pack that declares it, or the host (a document's channels).

name.description: A declaration's full name: its pack, a slash, its name (`core/date`, `doc/task`). A fn on a type adds a dot and the fn's name (`core/list.some`).

tokens.description: The tokens its look comes from: a case by its full name (`core/color.LINE`).

requires.description: What it expects of its inputs and slots: its `require` and `warn` blocks.

piece.description: The piece of Markdown it is, from `markdown #quote;`: `quote`. Its Markdown is that piece's, and `markdown` is left out.

markdown.description: What it writes as Markdown, from its markdown block. Left out when it writes nothing, or when it is a piece of Markdown.

levels.description: The levels drawing this widget needs beyond core.draw: those its `uses` names.

expose.description: Fns the host may call, answering the extern channel of the same name.

name.description: A declaration's full name: its pack, a slash, its name (`core/date`, `doc/task`). A fn on a type adds a dot and the fn's name (`core/list.some`).

field.description: A record's field, a widget's input or own variable, or a `$state` field.

require.description: A rule, checked whenever a value it reads changes: `require` refuses, `warn` only tells the host.

warn.description: A `warn` block: false is told, and refuses nothing.

type.description: A type. `name` is a built-in type (`core/number`, `core/list`, …), a declared one (an alias among them), a type parameter (capitals), or `fn`, `record` or `any`, which use the parts that follow.

returns.description: For `fn`; left out when it returns nothing.

contract.description: What narrows a type. Every part that is given has to hold.

bounds.description: Both ends are included; a missing one is open.

expr.description: An expression. Values are expressions too.

oneOf.description: A record made; its rules run when it is made.
An enum's or a token's case, with its values.
A token, by its name. An engine draws it with its own value.
A token made from a plain value, through its case that carries one: `stroke.PX(2.5)`.
A `core/rich_text`, its Markdown already read.
Whether a rich_text is a sentence, and not blocks.
A literal with holes: a text when `type` is `core/text`, a `core/template` otherwise.
A view as a value: a description of a call, drawn where it is placed.
A call of a fn held in a value.
A value shown as text, as a hole shows it.
Where a `mut` argument writes.
The value, or `none` when one of its contracts or rules fails.

op_name.description: An operator, by its symbol. `-` with one argument negates; `?` takes a condition and two values.

call.description: A call of a fn by its full name: one written in Extended Mark, an extern, or an interface's, which goes to the fn of the value's own type.

get.description: A read of something by name.

oneOf.description: A local, a parameter or a loop variable.
An input of the widget the code is in.
A widget's own variable.
A field of the document's `$state`.
A top-level `let`, by its full name.
A named token: `core/space.S`.
A slot of the widget the code is in.
A value of an extern channel: `core/page.width`, `doc/scores.unit`.

place.description: Where a write goes: a root and a path of fields and items.

rich.description: A rich_text: calls, as a value. A sentence's are drawn among words; `blocks` says they are blocks instead.

stmt.description: A statement of a fn, a handler or a rule.

oneOf.description: A local.
`over` is a list, a range, or for `mut for` a place.
An action.
An action held in a value.

template.description: A widget written in Extended Mark, lowered: its view as nodes. The document's own view is the template `doc`.

name.description: A declaration's full name: its pack, a slash, its name (`core/date`, `doc/task`). A fn on a type adds a dot and the fn's name (`core/list.some`).

cells.description: Its own variables, each with its starting value.

markdown.description: Its markdown block, lowered onto core's extern Markdown blocks; built from the view for a document's widget that has none. Left out when it is the view itself, and empty when it writes nothing.

levels.description: The levels this widget needs wherever it is called, beyond core.draw: its own variables need core.live, and it needs every level its view's calls need.

node.description: A node of a template's view.

extern.description: An extern widget, drawn by the engine.

levels.description: The levels this call needs beyond core.draw (page 6), its slots' included.

use.description: A widget written in Extended Mark.

levels.description: The levels this call needs beyond core.draw (page 6), its slots' included.

key.description: Rows of a list follow their items; rows of a range are keyed by their number.

place.description: A view value or a slot, drawn here.

sentence.description: It goes in a sentence, so a rich_text placed here is one: blocks are a failure.

handler.description: What runs when an event fires.
